about: The next generation of THE KING OF FIGHTERS is here! Featuring one of the biggest character rosters in the series, 50 characters battle it out in the iconic 3-on-3 TEAM BATTLE system. Bursting into full 3D graphics, witness the 2D fighting action in a completely new dimension at 1080p - 60fps. Burn To Fight!
• 50 fighters join the tournament in one of KOF’s biggest rosters!
• Duke it out in up to 12-player online PARTY BATTLES
• The full STORY MODE continues KOF XIV’s robust tale
• New CLIMAX CANCELS deeply evolve KOF’s special move mechanic. Chain special moves to create ultra-destructive combos!
• Unleash EX specials to enhance your attacks in the improved MAX MODE
• Perform combos by tapping the ‘Square’ button with RUSH MODE!
• Train with friends in the Online training mode, or spectate battles and capture fights
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
summary: The next generation of THE KING OF FIGHTERS is here! Featuring one of the biggest character rosters in the series, 50 characters battle it out in the iconic 3-on-3 TEAM BATTLE system.
